h1: Profile pages with settings, avatars and preferences
overview: A good profile page makes your product feel personal. We build a page where each user can edit their name and details, upload an avatar that is resized and checked, and choose preferences such as language, time zone and theme. We validate every field, save changes safely and show a clear confirmation. If you need public profiles, we add a shareable page with privacy controls.

faq: In file storage you already use, such as Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2 or Firebase Storage, or on your server. We resize them so pages stay quick, and we reject unsafe files.
Can users delete their profile data?
We can add a delete-photo and clear-field option. Full account deletion has legal and data aspects, so tell us your needs. We do not give legal advice but build the tools your policy requires.
Will this fit my existing design?
Yes. We use your fonts, colors and components, so the page looks like it was always part of your product. Send a link or design files if you have them.
Can you import profile photos from social login?
Where the provider allows it, yes. We use the picture from Google or similar as a starting point that the user can replace, and we follow each provider's rules.
